statement.p: Find the distance from (-9,7,-10) to each of the following:

solution.p: 1. The distance from a point to the xy-plane is the absolute value of the z-coordinate of the point. Thus, the distance is \left| -10 \right| = 10.
2. The distance from a point to the yz-plane is the absolute value of the x-coordinate of the point. Thus, the distance is \left| -9 \right| = 9.
3. The distance from a point to the xz-plane is the absolute value of the y-coordinate of the point. Thus, the distance is \left| 7 \right| = 7.
4. The point on the x-axis closest to (-9, 7, -10) is the point (-9, 0,0 ), (Approach the x-axis perpendicularly.)
The distance from (-9, 7, -10) to the x-axis is the distance between these two points:
5. The point on the y-axis closest to (-9, 7, -10) is the point (0, 7,0 ), (Approach the y-axis perpendicularly.)
The distance from (-9, 7, -10) to the y-axis is the distance between these two points:
6. The point on the z-axis closest to (-9, 7, -10) is the point (0, 0,-10 ), (Approach the z-axis perpendicularly.)
The distance from (-9, 7, -10) to the z-axis is the distance between these two points:
